about: The Stick frame-time budget: a regression ratchet held by tools/frame-budget.mjs. Each ceiling is the accepted P8 delivery soak plus a stated tolerance, so a change that makes the Stick slower fails loudly. It is NOT the 16.7/33 ms target: the owner deferred closing that gate (docs/concepts/DEATH-RIDE-BACKLOG.md), and the targets below are recorded, not gating. Only a Stick soak counts: a desktop soak runs vsync-capped on a far faster GPU and never stands in for Stick timing (tools/perf-desktop.py). Tighten a ceiling when a new soak beats it; never loosen one to let a change through (.ai/memory/0020).
shape: tools/perf-summary.py output (activeWindows / sixLiveWindows, each with count, worstP95Ms, maxMs, p50RangeMs, stepWorstP95Ms)
tolerance: worst window p95 +1 ms (about one vsync jitter), worst frame +10% (single frames are noisy), every window median at most 18 ms (near-60 Hz), simulation step p95 +0.5 ms

activeWindows.what: every 10 s window at least 10 s into a race

sixLiveWindows.what: the same windows with all six cars live (the heaviest scene)

targets.why: the product target; open by owner decision until the optimisation pass (docs/concepts/DEATH-RIDE-BACKLOG.md)
